name: redact
description: Swaps secret-shaped values and email addresses for numbered placeholders (API_KEY_1, EMAIL_1) in everything the model is sent, from the first request on, keeps the real values in a local vault per session, and puts them back in every tool call's input and in the terminal. Refuses a placeholder it cannot restore and changes to its own config. /redact show lists the rules in a pane, where you add and remove your own.

patterns.title: Extra patterns
patterns.description: Regex sources masked on top of the built-in rules, each match whole (a lookbehind keeps a prefix), labelled by the first named group, SECRET without one. A list, so set it in settings.json pluginConfigs: /config does not show list fields
